description: Non-AI path-consumer inventory (plan §2.3): one classified row per production module that can discover, read, copy, log, attach, back up, stage, or serialize task/workflow paths. The mechanical columns (`signals`, per-call-site `callSites` with compiler spans) are regenerated by scripts/generateWorkflowPathConsumers.mjs --generate over the exact §1.1 source universe and diffed against the live scan; sinkCategories, pathSource, expectedHandling, classifierCall, and migrationCohort are human-authored and preserved across regeneration. The immutable pre-gate reference lives in workflow-path-consumer-pregate-v1.json; drift from it requires annotations in workflow-path-consumer-annotations-v1.json, child_process consumers require dynamicPathConsumption annotations, and verify:workflow-path-consumers fails on any unclassified, stale, or missing row and on any unknown sink category or cohort.

consumers.pathSource: Task-folder artifact paths derived from the resolved task context (task.md/plan.md existence checks for stage eligibility).
consumers.expectedHandling: Reads only task-owned artifact paths; must call the classifier before treating any path as artifact-safe once the privacy cohort lands.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 at each artifact existence check (plan §2.2)

consumers.pathSource: Workspace directory tree walked to offer publish-scope candidates.
consumers.expectedHandling: Enumeration only; must exclude private/control paths from offered scopes once the classifier lands.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 filter on enumerated candidates (plan §2.2)

consumers.pathSource: Task-folder paths (Include Task Folder staging proposal) and workspace file paths from git status.
consumers.expectedHandling: Plan §2.4: index/privacy checks before lint/prompts and after staging, classifying rename/copy/deletion records by origin AND destination; private/control paths omitted from staging proposals. The git cohort implements the exact checked staging list.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — isWorkflowPrivatePathV1 on every staged record before commit (plan §2.4)

consumers.expectedHandling: Reads/writes task.md only (route currently gate-disabled); the text2 cohort moves writes behind the coordinator's revision-checked promotion.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 before prompt attachment and artifact write (plan §2.2)

consumers.expectedHandling: Reads task.md into the plan prompt, writes plan.md (route currently gate-disabled); text1 moves promotion behind the coordinator.

consumers.expectedHandling: Global assistant reads workspace state for answers; must never attach Chat-private or workflow-control files once classification exists.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — isWorkflowPrivatePathV1 on every attachment candidate (plan §2.2)

consumers.expectedHandling: Read-only artifact access plus progress display-name writes; rename surface is unchanged by the plan.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 before the task.md read (plan §2.2)

consumers.expectedHandling: The largest legacy consumer: review/implementation flows read artifacts into prompts and write review artifacts (currently gate-disabled), and spawn git for diff context. Splits across text3 (reviews) and edit (implementation/fast-forward) cohorts; every prompt attachment must classify once the privacy cohort lands.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 at prompt-attachment and artifact-write choke points (plan §2.2)

consumers.expectedHandling: Creates task folders/seed files; consults (never promotes) the startup gate's read-only classification. The creation cohort replaces ad-hoc creation writes with intent/journal/sentinel records under the path registry.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 on creation write targets (plan §2.2)

consumers.pathSource: Task-folder task.md/task-progress.json/sentinel paths from the fresh plan §4.3 reclassification taken immediately before mutating.
consumers.expectedHandling: Retry/Adopt-and-Retry write task.md only when absent (never overwritten); Safe Delete reads the directory listing to revalidate against its durable journal before permanently removing exactly the journaled entries, then the now-empty folder. All four commands consult (never bypass) the fresh classification; adoption is itself journaled (taskAdoptionIntentStoreV1.ts) before any sentinel commit.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — call site to be assigned with the classifier (plan §2.2)

consumers.pathSource: Meta-resources folder path and .gitignore path; git check-ignore child process.
consumers.expectedHandling: Maintains the automatic .gitignore entry that keeps meta resources out of the repo — itself a privacy control; the classifier must treat the meta root as workflow-control.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 on the meta root (plan §2.2)

consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 on backup source/target (plan §2.2)

consumers.classifierCall: n/a (extension-owned storage directory, not a task/workflow path the privacy classifier scopes)

Runner invocation is currently rejected at the boundary backstop.

consumers.expectedHandling: The edit-capable runner. The edit cohort replaces direct tool file access with the request-local read tools + sealed-manifest broker (plan §7); until then the route gate and boundary backstop keep it unreachable.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 inside every tool read/write handler (plan §2.2/§7.2)

consumers.expectedHandling: Read-only comparison of a candidate task.md's bytes against the shipped historical-seed corpus for TaskCreationStartupReconcilerV1's `pristine` classification (plan §4.3); never writes, never touches Chat-private or task-owned data.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 not required (extension-bundled resource paths only, no task/workflow path reaches this module)

consumers.expectedHandling: Read-only strict discovery (plan §3.12): findAllTasksStrictV1/findIncompleteTasksStrictV1 return { tasks, recovery } — decodable folders as tasks, undecodable ones as recovery entries with codes — replacing the retired permissive findAllTasks; never writes.
consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — call site to be assigned with the classifier (plan §2.2)

consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — call site to be assigned with the classifier (plan §2.2)

consumers.pathSource: Every registered workflow root (task folders, private storage) — task-local chat-v1.json, the durable Chat interaction transaction store, and future workflow-runtime-v1 families.
consumers.expectedHandling: The one §1.8 mutation surface: exclusive creation, revision-guarded replacement, bounded reads, nonrecursive directory create/remove, exact-file unlink. Revalidates root/path safety (workflowPathSafetyV1.ts) immediately before every mutation. Never writes Chat-private content anywhere the privacy classifier would reject.
consumers.classifierCall: n/a (generic mutation surface; callers — chatHistoryStore.ts, chatInteractionTransactionStoreV1.ts — are responsible for classifying what they write before calling it)

consumers.pathSource: Candidate workflow root paths (task folders, private storage) at registration time — stats path components for the reparse/symlink check.
consumers.expectedHandling: Root/path shape validation only (absolute non-UNC roots, no traversal/backslash in registered-family locators, no reparse-point component). Read-only; performs no content access.
consumers.classifierCall: n/a (root/path shape validation, not content classification)

consumers.pathSource: A candidate task folder's task-progress.json, read on EVERY trusted-root registration call (verifyTaskFolderOwnershipBindingV1 behind ensureWorkflowTaskFolderRootV1, and the mirrored absence check in ensureWorkflowNonTaskStorageRootV1) to strictly validate it before the folder is trusted for mutation — the strict task contract requires the file to exist and decode, the persisted taskFolder field to name the exact folder being registered, and a validated persisted ownership record (the implementation review's mutation-authority blocker).
consumers.expectedHandling: Read-only trust check. ensureWorkflowTaskFolderRootV1 refuses registration (throws) when task-progress.json is missing (a folder without progress is not a task folder — dedicated non-task storage registers through ensureWorkflowNonTaskStorageRootV1 instead), unreadable as a regular file, fails strict decode, names a different folder, or carries no validatable ownership binding; ensureWorkflowNonTaskStorageRootV1 refuses any folder that DOES carry task progress.
consumers.classifierCall: n/a (progress-file trust validation, not content classification)

consumers.classifierCall: pending:privacy — classifyWorkflowPathV1 on journal paths (plan §2.2)

Full Retry/Adopt-and-Retry/Safe Delete recovery (plan §§4.4-4.6) lands with a later Creation-cohort slice.
